name: Three Crowns - WhatsApp GREEN API AI Administrator

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const type=b.typeWebhook||''; const md=b.messageData||{}; const sd=b.senderData||{}; const text=md?.textMessageData?.textMessage || md?.extendedTextMessageData?.text || md?.quotedMessage?.textMessage || ''; const chatId=sd.chatId || sd.sender || ''; const idMessage=b.idMessage || ''; const isGuestText=type==='incomingMessageReceived' && Boolean(chatId) && Boolean(String(text).trim()); return [{json:{raw:b,is_guest_text:isGuestText,chat_id:String(chatId),message_id:String(idMessage),sender_name:String(sd.senderName||sd.senderContactName||''),text:String(text).trim()}}];

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.OPENAI_WHATSAPP_MODEL || $env.OPENAI_SALES_MODEL, input: `Extract booking-search facts from this guest WhatsApp message for Three Crowns Resort. Return ONLY valid JSON with keys: intent (AVAILABILITY|HOTEL_QUESTION|BOOKING_INTENT|MANAGER|OTHER), check_in (YYYY-MM-DD|null), check_out (YYYY-MM-DD|null), adults (integer|null), children (integer|null), room_type_code (string|null), language (ru|kg|en), summary (short string). Current hotel timezone is Asia/Bishkek. Never invent missing values. Message: ${$('Normalize GREEN Event').item.json.text}` }) }}

parameters.jsCode: const p=$json; let text=p.output_text; if(!text && Array.isArray(p.output)){ const parts=[]; for(const i of p.output){ for(const c of (i.content||[])){ if(c.type==='output_text'&&c.text) parts.push(c.text); } } text=parts.join('\n'); } if(!text) throw new Error('OpenAI intent extractor returned no text'); text=String(text).trim().replace(/^```(?:json)?/i,'').replace(/```$/,'').trim(); const intent=JSON.parse(text); const complete=Boolean(intent.check_in&&intent.check_out&&Number.isInteger(Number(intent.adults))&&Number(intent.adults)>0); return [{json:{...$('Normalize GREEN Event').item.json,intent,complete_search:complete}}];

const facts=$('Get Verified Hotel Facts').item.json; const parsed=$('Parse Intent').item.json; const availability=$json; const options=(availability.results||[]).filter(x=>x.pricing?.sellable===true&&Number.isFinite(x.pricing?.total_kgs)).slice(0,8).map(x=>({room_type_code:x.room_type_code,room_type_name:x.room_type_name,area:x.area,available_count:x.available_count,total_kgs:x.pricing.total_kgs,nights:availability.nights})); return [{json:{...parsed,verified_context:{hotel_facts:facts,current_availability:{check_in:availability.check_in,check_out:availability.check_out,nights:availability.nights,adults:availability.adults,children:availability.children,options}}}}];
const facts=$('Get Verified Hotel Facts').item.json; return [{json:{...$json,verified_context:{hotel_facts:facts,current_availability:null}}}];

const p=$json; let text=p.output_text; if(!text&&Array.isArray(p.output)){const parts=[];for(const i of p.output){for(const c of(i.content||[])){if(c.type==='output_text'&&c.text)parts.push(c.text)}}text=parts.join('\n')} if(!text) throw new Error('OpenAI reply composer returned no text'); return [{json:{chat_id:$('Normalize GREEN Event').item.json.chat_id,message_id:$('Normalize GREEN Event').item.json.message_id,reply:String(text).trim().slice(0,12000)}}];
